hash_change_explanation: Root requested a correction to the inherited misleading comment that embedded CUDA remained unchanged. The final hash changes only that provenance comment from the earlier reviewed hash. The critic re-ran the complete CPU suite with the final hash verified before and after execution.
decision: GO for one official private whole-decoder check of these exact bytes. No scored promotion or GPU correctness/performance certification.

independent_validation.scope_limit: CPU models cover address equivalence, entry order/ownership and abstract producer/consumer ring events. They do not test actual CUDA instruction ordering, register allocation, GPU races, numerical output or latency.

source_audit: Read the complete focused diff against the frozen parent and confirmed the only changed Python AST nodes are bfp_SK2_SRC and the extension builder.
Independently normalized the extension namespace and established AST equality of the full builder to the parent.
New correction branch is compile-time COMP && CL == 1. Cluster and uncompressed branches remain logically unchanged.
All original escape warps, correction planes, plane-zeroing, FP32 multiply/add expression, per-plane entry order and final plane reduction order are retained.
Four empty-barrier initializers exclude escape arrivals only in the new branch. Actual regular consumers still release every weight and fused-router stage; final cbar remains 32*NESC arrivals.
All escape lanes arrive at cbar, including padded token lanes. Consumers wait before reading corrections or reusing ring storage. No new CTA-wide barrier was introduced after early returns.
The global input pointer and 3D BF16 TMA map use the same x.data_ptr(), M and K; checked dimensions64,M,K/64 and strides2*K,128.

Existing all-thread griddepcontrol.wait precedes the new global input reads. UV uses the actual contiguous BF16 xuv rows at physical M=2T; normalizations and BND/FUSE transformations remain in the existing epilogues.
Launch dimensions, dynamic shared-memory formula and actual-specialization occupancy query remain unchanged; the query and launches reference the renamed kernel.
runtime_requirements: All 13 official numerical tests and 12 timed cases must pass without flags or rejections.
Confirm modified sk2_global_escape_kernel appears in the profile for affected small-T projections; large-T paths are controls.
Inspect compiler/resource changes and benchmark cases before any score decision. Extra strided scalar global reads or a late correction tail may outweigh removed ring waits.
